baseline_models.mechanism: The selection branch is sharpened by the same root's collection branch: election gathers Joseph out of an undifferentiated field and draws him near for a particular charge.

activation_trace.role: Choosing and drawing near supply the explicit act and make the promise a directed appointment.
Collecting and acquiring add centripetal motion, so choosing also gathers Joseph into the Lord's purpose.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord will prefer and choose Joseph.
changed_reading.after: Your Lord will gather Joseph out, draw him near, and appoint him to a particular charge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence your Lord, teaches you, completes, and completed it at 12:6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship supplies repair and upbringing, the secondary resolved growth branch supplies nourishment and emergence, and completion supplies the reached limit; the coordinated futures therefore form one developmental process rather than three detached gifts.

activation_trace.role: Repair, upbringing, and stagewise completion make lordship the process that develops the recipient.
Nourishment and growth make the promised changes an emergence through stages, not an instantaneous grant.
Reaching a full limit gives the developmental sequence its promised horizon.
Good condition and bestowed benefit identify what the process is bringing to fullness.

changed_reading.before: The Lord chooses, teaches, and then adds a completed favor as separate benefits.
changed_reading.after: The Lord cultivates Joseph through a connected course whose teaching and growth bring an inherited benefit to fullness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked focus construction teaches you from the interpretation of the ahadith.
baseline_models.mechanism: Teaching, return-to-outcome, and the double range of occurrence and report produce a hermeneutic that moves from fresh speech or lived event toward its consequence and governing sense.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the acquisition of intelligibility.
Return to an eventual outcome supplies the direction of interpretation.
A thing newly coming to be keeps lived occurrences inside the object of interpretation.
Renewed speech and report preserve the utterance and narrative side of ahadith.

changed_reading.before: Joseph will be taught the interpretation of dreams or sayings.
changed_reading.after: Joseph will learn to return both reports and newly occurring events to the outcomes and governing sense toward which they move.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root at words 6 and 12 spans interpretation and the household of Jacob, followed by the two fathers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same focus root carries outcome-return and the household as those who return to one another; this couples the epistemic gift to a reciprocal lineage rather than leaving interpretation as an individual possession.

activation_trace.role: Return to consequence supplies the motion internal to interpretation.
A household constituted by reciprocal return makes that same motion relational and genealogical.
Fatherhood as origin and nurture extends the promised benefit through a formative lineage.

changed_reading.before: Favor is bestowed on Joseph and also on Jacob's household.
changed_reading.after: Joseph's return-reading is embedded in a household of reciprocal return, so the gift is answerable to a lineage and not complete as private expertise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair Knowing, Wise at 12:6 words 24-25.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge discloses the pattern, while wisdom prevents corruption for repair and brings a matter into firm order; the closing titles state how the promised process can be governed.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to knowledge supplies complete awareness of the developing pattern.
Restraint and rebuttal for repair make wisdom an active check on corrupting force.
Firm ordering and exact construction make wisdom the means by which the process holds together.

changed_reading.before: Knowing and Wise are general closing attributes.
changed_reading.after: Knowing names full disclosure of the pattern, while Wise names the restraining and ordering governance that lets the promise reach completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs and track-following narrative revise interpretation into a method: notice marks, follow their ordered sequence, and return the sequence to its consequence.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides makes teaching a capacity for reading evidence.
Return to outcome gives the evidential path its destination.
A manifest sign supplies the observable unit from which interpretation can begin.
Following a trace supplies the inferential movement from one mark to the next.
A sequentially conducted report turns dispersed traces into a coherent history.

structural_cues: 12:1 names the disclosed text as signs before 12:6 promises teaching.
12:3 repeats the narrative root in verb and noun, presenting the story as an ordered sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, track-following, sequential report, and return-to-outcome; I infer a method from marks through sequence to consequence. A narrower live alternative limits the promise chiefly to dream interpretation.

changed_reading.before: Teaching interpretation means receiving meanings for difficult dreams or sayings.
changed_reading.after: Teaching interpretation includes learning to read visible marks, follow event tracks, and infer the outcome that makes their sequence coherent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dream is not an isolated image: repeated seeing culminates in an embodied posture, so interpretation maps a symbolic tableau onto a future social configuration.

activation_trace.role: Return to eventual consequence makes the vision legible through what its arrangement becomes.
Dream vision supplies the symbolic mode that calls for an outcome beyond immediate sight.
A lowered head and bent posture give the celestial image a concrete relational geometry.

structural_cues: 12:4 repeats the seeing verb around the celestial tableau.
12:5 immediately treats narration of the vision as socially consequential.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dream, a posture of lowering, and an immediate warning about its social effect; I infer an image-to-relation mapping. The live alternative is a less specific promise of honor rather than a mapped future order.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation extracts a hidden proposition from a dream.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation follows a dream's embodied arrangement into the future relation among the people represented by it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The household of reciprocal return is immediately shown as kinship distorted by scarce love, encircling group solidarity, and intrigue; completion upon the family must therefore include relational repair or reordering, not merely parallel gifts.

activation_trace.role: A household defined by reciprocal return supplies the relational field in which favor must become complete.
Bestowed good condition supplies the promised change to that damaged field.
Actual brotherhood anchors the hostile actors inside, rather than outside, the named household.
Intrigue turns kinship into an active mechanism of displacement.
Love lodged in the heart becomes the contested good around which rivalry forms.
An encircling, mutually supporting band explains how individual resentment acquires collective force.

structural_cues: 12:6 extends favor to the household; 12:7 immediately presents Joseph-with-brothers as signs.
12:8 compares paternal love and invokes band strength before the violent proposals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household return, brothers, contested love, band solidarity, and plot; I infer that family completion answers the rupture generated by those relations. A live alternative is that the promised household denotes a later or narrower lineage, not every current antagonist.

changed_reading.before: The same favor will separately reach Joseph and his family.
changed_reading.after: The favor is not complete while Joseph's household remains a rivalry machine; its family scope anticipates repair or reordering of the very kinship that expels him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wisdom as preventative repair appears narratively as constrained harm: a fatal proposal is negated and redirected into casting Joseph into a containing depth, preserving a route toward completion without erasing hostile agency.

activation_trace.role: Restraint for repair supplies the governing logic by which destructive force can be checked.
The promised reached limit supplies what must remain possible through the intervention.
Actual killing supplies the terminal proposal that would close the promised path.
The repeated killing image under negation marks the specific destructive limit being refused.
Casting supplies the substituted action, preserving violence while changing its endpoint.
A cavity that receives something supplies containment in place of death.

structural_cues: 12:9 proposes killing; 12:10 repeats it under prohibition and substitutes casting.
The substitute remains harmful, so the sequence depicts limitation and redirection rather than simple rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fatal proposal, its negation, a substituted casting, and the focus image of preventative wisdom; I infer a governing arrow from restraint to preserved completion. The live alternative is that this is only one brother's mitigation and should not be made a transparent account of divine causation.

changed_reading.before: Divine wisdom means the promised gifts are wisely selected.
changed_reading.after: Divine wisdom can work as a precise restraint on destructive agency, redirecting rather than abolishing harm so the promised completion remains open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future completion is followed by concealment in a depth and patient self-restraint; completion therefore functions as a horizon that holds a fractured interval together, not as immediate insulation from incompletion.

activation_trace.role: Fullness at a reached limit supplies the still-future endpoint.
Reaching an appointed measure adds temporal ripening rather than instantaneous possession.
A depression in which something disappears supplies the abrupt interval of hiddenness.
Holding the self from collapse supplies the posture by which the unfinished interval is endured.

structural_cues: Every major promise in 12:6 is future-facing.
The following sequence reaches concealment, a false report, and patience before any visible completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future completion, immediate hiddenness, and patience; I infer that the promise organizes a long interval of apparent noncompletion. A live alternative is that completion names a remote gift without making each intervening injury one of its means.

changed_reading.before: Completion of favor should appear as near and cumulative protection.
changed_reading.after: Completion is the promised limit that makes a concealed and fractured middle narratively endurable, not a guarantee against that middle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human custodians claim trust and preservation, then anticipate that their report will not be believed; the final appeal for help relocates effective custody from the encircling kin group to the Lord named in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Possession and responsible lordship supply the ultimate custodial relation.
Sustained care and repair distinguish lordly custody from a momentary human claim.
Heart-settling trust supplies the custody the brothers solicit but do not honor.
Guarding and watchfulness supply their explicit but failed promise of preservation.
Belief that can settle the heart returns as something their fabricated account cannot secure.
Aid and backing relocate dependable support to God after human custody collapses.

structural_cues: The claims of trust and guarding in 12:11-12 precede the betrayal.
The speakers in 12:17 preemptively concede the unbelievability of their account; 12:18 seeks divine help.

changed_reading.after: Selection may be strangely enacted through being cut from one field, contained in a depth, and picked up into another trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Completing favor means adding benefits until their quantity is full.
changed_reading.after: Completion can be carried as the missing piece that eventually repairs a lineage whose first textile sign has been made to lie.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary resolved mapping from the focus root to a sequence-and-stewardship inventory; it remains anchored in the focus root spanning interpretation and household and is reinforced by sequential narration. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root shared by interpretation and household, with the packet's secondary mapped inventory.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another without a break supplies interpretation as disciplined sequence-tracking.
Taking charge of an affair supplies a custodial dimension: the interpreter orders rather than merely decodes events.
A report conducted in succession supplies the narrative form over which such stewardship operates.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation extracts a concealed meaning from a finished sign.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation may also mean following and responsibly ordering an unfolding sequence until each event takes its consequential place.

strongest_changes: Interpretation expanded from dream decoding to sign-reading, track-following, consequence inference, and the conversion of suffered events into witness.
Selection, teaching, and completion became one cultivated course whose promised horizon remains active through concealment and constrained harm.
Favor upon Jacob's household became a relational repair problem because the named kinship is the very machinery of rivalry and expulsion.
Knowing and Wise became operational: disclosure reads the pattern, while restraint and firm ordering keep destructive agency from closing it.
The false-blood shirt made discrimination of counterfeit evidence a central changed reading.
summary.what_was_special: The focus contains an unusually dense set of internal hinges: the same root links outcome-reading with Jacob's household, selection carries both choosing and gathering, lordship resolves into cultivation and growth, and completion can be materially reactivated by the later lying garment. The context does not merely illustrate the promise; it converts its gifts into a method formed inside rivalry, hiddenness, misleading signs, and delayed outcomes.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ahadith should remain weighted toward dreams and reports or include lived events equally.
Whether completion upon the household includes the presently hostile brothers or a narrower or later lineage.
Whether the redirection from killing to the well should be read as divine governance, human mitigation, or both at different explanatory levels.
The sound-neighbor and secondary-mapping outliers are inspectable activations but should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Selection gathers Yusuf toward an eventual outcome.** ج ب ي B004 (choosing and drawing near), ء و ل B002 (return to outcome/final meaning), and ت م م B001 (full completion) produce a temporal mechanism. I infer that selection is not a single elevation but entry into a process whose scattered events return as intelligible completion. `تأويل الأحاديث` reads as governing events toward their disclosed outcome as well as interpreting reports.
2. **Lordship works as repair.** ر ب ب B002 (repair, nurture, completion), ن ع م B001 (bestowed favor), and ح ك م B001/B003 (restraining to set right; rightly guided knowledge) connect care to judgment. I infer that the later reversals are instruments of formation. The ayah reads as a promise of restorative cultivation, not uninterrupted ease.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100-101 showed selection and تأويل completing in rule, reunion, and prayer; completion proved restorative but not equivalent to uninterrupted ease.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Interpretation as return to an outcome.** `ء و ل:B002` is “return to outcome or final meaning”; its scope explicitly includes interpretation as returning speech to what it comes to mean. The window places the dream before this promise and the brothers’ grievance and elimination proposals after it (12:8-10). Those fragments are supplied; I infer that interpretation discovers how apparently adverse steps are carried to an eventual result. *Taʾwīl al-aḥādīth* consequently reads as outcome-tracing through events, not only dream decoding.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100 names the realized scene as the dream's *taʾwīl*, confirming that interpretation here is not merely explanation but the return of an image-complex to an embodied outcome.

branches.branch_image_ar: خثور السائل وانعقاده في آخر أمره
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آل اللبن أو النبات أو القطران أو العسل إذا خثر أو انعقد، والآيل اللبن الخاثر.

branches.branch_image_ar: آلة الحال التي يكون عليها الشيء

يدخل فيه الآلة بمعنى الأداة، وخشبات الخيمة، والجنازة أو الحامل الذي يحمل عليه.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نعم الشيء إذا لان، والناعم والمنعم والمناعم، والتنعم وطيب العيش والترف، والطعام أو الشخص الموصوف بالنعومة أو الرفاه.
يدخل فيه نعم المقابلة لبئس، ونعم الشيء، ونعما، وفبها ونعمت، حيث تكون اللفظة فعلا أو صيغة مدح واستحسان.
يدخل فيه نعم حرفا أو كلمة جواب، للتصديق والإيجاب والعدة، وما اتصل بذلك مثل أنعم له أي قال له نعم.
يدخل فيه النعم والأنعام، خصوصا الإبل، وبالتوسيع الإبل والبقر والغنم والبهائم الراعية حيث نصت المصادر على ذلك.
يدخل فيه النعامة والنعام للطائر المعروف، ذكرا أو أنثى، وما يذكر من جنسه وصفاته المباشرة.
يدخل فيه المسميات المشبهة بالنعامة في الهيئة أو البعد أو السرعة، مثل خشبة البئر والظلة على رأس الجبل وباطن القدم أو عرق الرجل أو الساق والمحجة والنعائم من منازل القمر.
يدخل فيه شالت نعامتهم وخفت نعامتهم وأضحوا نعاما ونحوها، حيث يدل التعبير على الارتحال أو التفرق أو ذهاب العز أو الهزيمة.
يدخل فيه النعامى، وهي ريح الجنوب اللينة أو الأرطب والأبل في الهبوب.
يدخل فيه فعل كذا وأنعم بمعنى زاد، وأنعم في الدق أو الإحسان بمعنى بالغ وزاد، وأنعما في الخبر بمعنى زادا على ذلك.
يدخل فيه أتيت أرضا فتنعمتني أو فنعمتني، إذا وافقت الشخص وأقام بها أو طاب له النزول.
يدخل فيه تنعمت فلانا إذا أتيته على غير دابة أو طلبته ماشيا، وتنعم القدمين أي ابتذلهما، وما قرب منه من المشي الخفيف.
